title: MILF infighting sends civilians fleeing in Maguindanao del Sur

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Hostilities between rival Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) members in Shariff Aguak, Maguindanao del Sur, erupted anew before dawn Wednesday, uprooting civilians from their homes, officials said. Shariff Aguak Vice Mayor Hadji Oping Ampatuan said the infighting among MILF members broke out in Barangay Bialong but was immediately defused on Tuesday by the peace mechanisms of the government and the MILF. “However, fighting between the same groups erupted anew at about 1 a.m. Wednesday,” Ampatuan said.
